description: Department of Elections - Appoint Mr. R. Saseelan as Returning Officer of Puthukudiyiruppu and Maritime Pattu Pradeshiya Sabhas
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the appointment of Returning Officers for Local Authorities elections in the Mullaitivu Administrative District. It is issued by the Commissioner of Elections under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly related to electoral processes and administration, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
